headline: Indian Corporate Earnings Exceed Projections in Strongest Quarter Since Late 2023
summary: Around 67% of companies in HSBC's India coverage reported earnings at or above consensus expectations. Full-year earnings growth for India Inc is projected at 14%.
why: Quarterly earnings results from major Indian listed companies serve as a benchmark for corporate growth and economic trajectory in South Asia.

impacts.name: BSE SENSEX
impacts.why: Earnings beats across two-thirds of covered Indian firms boost index sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Stronger-than-expected corporate net income results supported equity market valuations in India.
